intro: Dorius Stonetender is badly hurt in Searing Gorge, light-headed, with the world spinning and bleeding inside. He says he must get back to Ironforge and begs for your help to get him there.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm badly injured, traveler. Feel... Light headed... World spinning... Bleeding... Internally.
I must get back to Ironforge. Help me, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm not going to make it...

clips.title: Completion
paras: This letter was dropped by Dorius when he was shot.
